environment.description: Tomcat 9.0 application server running on Amazon EC2 (m5.large), connected to PostgreSQL 14 RDS instance (db.r5.large). The RDS security group allows inbound from the app server SG on port 5432. The JDBC connection pool uses a role 'report_app' which has been granted SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on all tables in the 'public' schema, plus USAGE on all sequences. The application is fronted by an AWS ALB with a simple HTTP listener forwarding to the target group on port 8080. No additional middleware or request filtering is configured on the ALB. The RDS parameter group uses default settings with statement_timeout=0.

config.alb_rules: default action: forward to target group
